Jofra Archer to Shubman Gill - FOUR MORE! Gujarat Titans have got off to a positive start here in Mullanpur. Good length delivery drifting into the pads. Gill flicks it away towards the deep backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Jofra Archer to Shubman Gill - Good length shaping away from outside off. Gill opens the bat face and steers it to deep third man for a single.

Jofra Archer to B Sai Sudharsan - FOUR RUNS! Make that the fourth boundary of the over. Expensive start from Jofra Archer. Hard length delivery around fourth stump, swings back in from round the wicket. Sudharsan hops, gets on top of the bounce and punches it past the left of deep third man for a boundary.
Nandre Burger to Shubman Gill - FIVE WIDES! More runs for the Titans. That goes through the gap of first slip and the keeper.

Yash Punja to Shubman Gill - Delivers a slider from the corner of the crease, on a length, at the off pole. Gill chops it towards backward point and denies the single. Sudharsan wanted it, the GT skipper did not.

Yash Punja to Shubman Gill - NAILED! FOUR! Excellent use of the feet from the GT skipper. Similar length, 93.8 kph, outside off. Gill jumped out of his crease and hammered it through extras over. The fielder inside the circle had no chance as the ball flew to his right like a rocket.

Yash Punja to Shubman Gill - EVEN BETTER! FOUR MORE! Excellent from Gill. It is one-way traffic here. A tad fuller, closer to the off pole. He skipped out of his crease and lofted it using an inside-out drive towards extra cover. The ball went skipping away to the fence.
Yash Punja to Shubman Gill - Shorter length, googly, turns in towards the middle pole. 94.2 kph. Pulled in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket for two.
Nandre Burger to B Sai Sudharsan - Good length ball angled in at the middle pole from over the wicket. Sudharsan bunts it towards midwicket and picks one before the ball is fielded.

Nandre Burger to Shubman Gill - Around the wicket, delivers it at back of a length, outside off. Possibly a cutter. Gill waits for it to arrive and then, flat-bats it to long-off for one. 700 runs in the season for the GT captain!
